entries.reason: The linear-size equality family E_n(X,Y)=AND_i(x_i<->y_i) produces 2^n residual formulas Y=a after assigning X=a. For any distinct a,b, the common future assignment Y=a satisfies residual a and falsifies residual b. Therefore every continuation-complete quotient of all residual states requires at least 2^n classes, contradicting the polynomial class bound in H128.
salvage: H129 drops classification of all residuals and asks whether one explicit policy can visit only polynomially many selected states.
Family-specific Tears such as Tseitin component parity and 2-SAT SCC certificates remain valid restricted mechanisms.
H130 and H131 split the concrete no-cache and formula-caching lower-bound routes.
